IC1: Active proliferative diabetic retinopathy (PDR) in the study eye such as NVE [OR], NVD [OR], vitreous hemorrhage [OR], or neovascular glaucoma.
IC2: Uncontrolled hypertension defined as systolic [OR] >180 mmHg [OR] or > 160 mmHg on 2 consecutive measurements or diastolic > 100 mmHg on optimal medical regimen
IC4: Focal laser photocoagulation [OR] or intravitreal/periocular steroids of any type in the study eye within the last 90 days prior to study enrollment.
IC5: A history of intravitreal anti-VEGF injection of any type in the study eye within the last 45 days prior to study enrollment.
IC6: History of rhegmatogenous retinal detachment [OR], retinal tear(s) [OR], or traction retinal detachments in the study eye.
IC7: Epiretinal membrane [OR] and/or vitreomacular traction in the study eye as determined by the central reading center.
IC8: Previous pars plana vitrectomy in the study eye
IC9: Any intraocular surgery in the study eye within the last 90 days prior to study enrollment.
IC10: YAG laser treatment in the study eye in last 30 days prior to study enrollment.
IC11: High myopia [AND] in the study eye, with a spherical equivalent of >8.00D at screening
IC12: Other ocular pathologies that in the investigator's opinion would interfere with the subject's vision in the study eye.
IC14: Ongoing ocular [OR] infection or inflammation in either eye.
IC15: A history of cataract surgery complications [OR]/vitreous loss in the study eye.
IC16: Congenital eye malformations in the study eye.
IC17: A history of penetrating ocular trauma in the study eye.
IC19: Pregnant female, as determined for women less than 60 years old by a positive urine pregnancy test during the screening window.
IC21: Currently participating in any other clinical research study.
